route_trials.basis: runs/benchmark/bench_20.json: reference in-process 0.058 s per paired trial (A 0.017 s, B 0.042 s); worst-case batch-LM+Marginals proxy 0.77 s per paired trial (scripts/bench_slow.py). T=200 -> about 12 s (reference) to about 155 s (worst-case proxy) per evaluation before Docker IPC overhead. At T=200 the 95% Wilson half-width is at most 0.069, below the 0.15 stated-probability tolerance. Decision made once at T; intermediate results are progress only.
